name: Breakbeat / jungle
key_tendency: Minor keys (F minor, E minor); dark pads over a sub that moves rarely.
signature: Chopped and resequenced breakbeat (splice/chop on the brk sample)
Syncopated kick and snare reinforcing the break
Deep sine sub bass with long notes
Dark minor pad or stab, often with reverb
Ghost snares and rolls at the end of phrases
listen_for: The break is cut into 16 slices and replayed out of order, so it stutters and rolls. Underneath, the sub moves only once or twice per bar, at half the drum speed.

parts.bass:
const bass = note("<f1 f1 db1 eb1>").struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").s("sine")
  .decay(0.6).sustain(0.4).gain(0.7)
parts.chords:
const chords = chord("<Fm7 Fm7 Db^7 Eb>").voicing().s("gm_pad_warm")
  .room(0.6).gain(0.25)

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [8, stack(chords, fx)],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, chords)],
  [8, stack(chords, drums.mask("0 0 1 1").ply(2))],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, chords)],
)
